text: OpenAI released o3 and o4-mini on April 16, 2025 [Source: ev-1]. The launch signaled that the direction of frontier reasoning models is shifting toward native vision capabilities built directly into the model rather than being bolted on, as well as native tool use (such as web search and code interpreter) trained into the architecture itself [Source: ev-1]. Additionally, it marked OpenAI’s first private chain-of-thought policy where reasoning tokens are not exposed to API callers [Source: ev-1]. This move reframed frontier capability as "tool-using reasoning at commodity prices," evidenced by o4-mini’s pricing of $1.10 per million input tokens and $4.40 per million output tokens, compared to o3’s higher tier of $10 and $40 respectively [Source: ev-1].
